[[Moa'vu'Kaal]] was an ancient, evil [[Skale]] that may have been, according to [[Elder Belin]], touched by a [[Abaddon|dark, forgotten god]] and was capable of killing a man with its [[Gaze of Moa'vu'Kaal|gaze]].  In the [[quest]] [[Moa'vu'Kaal, Awakened]], he is brought back by the Skale worshipping him, and he must be defeated to complete the quest.
